decisions.text: Preserve the production publisher wire payloads exactly in a newly produced capture and use authenticated HTTP response bodies for stored-record readback; do not substitute fixtures, direct SQL, or an unsupported claim that provider grading already occurred.

cohorts.description: A single oakridge cohort keeps the existing cross-package PR diff, focused checks, publication order, and assessment together as one coherent review unit; this is verification of an existing PR, not implementation.

acceptance_criteria.text: The complete brief and assessment retain criterion-lineage unchanged and link factual evidence from inspection of the live source launcher and current-definition v2 provenance validation: the artifact body is a newly produced capture of exact production publisher wire payloads, never a pre-existing observation fixture; the checked-out commit and gated-review-confirmed PR head are reported separately, and focused-check failures, skips, absent files, unavailable exact-head checkout, credentials, and other gaps are explicit.

The complete brief and assessment retain criterion-export unchanged and link factual evidence from inspection of authenticated tenant-scoped question/evidence routes and direct-provider readback through HTTP response bodies, distinguishing a production capture from any claim that provider grading occurred; exact focused-check counts and all checkout, file, credential, failure, and skip gaps are reported.

summary: One read-only oakridge cohort named slice audits the exact current head of existing PR #771, produces honest live-verification evidence, and preserves criterion-lineage, criterion-export, and decision-capture through the brief and assessment.
acceptance_criteria: Immediately before factual publication, gated-review confirms PR #771 status, branch cohort/live-verification/bc33be, and head SHA; the builder reports that head separately from the checked-out commit and does not substitute another snapshot.
The builder inspects the existing PR code, uses a newly produced production capture with no pre-existing observation fixture body, and does not claim provider grading unless it actually occurred.

Against the exact audited PR head, the builder runs only the gated-review tools smoke test, workflow-config definitions tests, and observation grading-records/direct-provider tests, publishing exact pass, failure, and skip counts plus every gap.

The builder publishes build_result first and then publishes existing PR #771 on cohort/live-verification/bc33be as the pr artifact, without edits, commits, pushes, new PRs, merges, resets, deployments, or server changes.
The assessor publishes factual findings for criterion-lineage and criterion-export using those unchanged IDs and the evidence actually produced.
